ranking.note: Raised: corrects documentation that is actively wrong (claims any SAM v3.1 router works), leading operators into connection failures — the category's top criterion, on par with the other P2s.
Raised: documents prerequisites and scope limits of a newly merged privacy feature where misconfiguration has privacy consequences; comparable durable value to #36829.
Lowered to match #30361: both are narrow developer-notes conventions with no user-facing or correctness consequence; similar consequence must share a band.

inconsistencies: #35518 and #35480 (same author) both document notification semantics under issue #14278 — overlapping scope; review #35518 first since it establishes the general async/no-ordering semantics that the ZMQ-specific guarantees in #35480 sit beside.
#35858 moves shared privacy text out of doc/i2p.md while #36829 edits doc/i2p.md; merge order matters — whichever lands second will need rebasing of the i2p.md section.

#30361 (developer logging guidance) and #36900 (mutation-test referencing convention) are the same kind of change — internal contributor conventions — and were originally split across P4 and P3; now banded together.
result.notes: Band spread is intentional: three P2s where documentation is wrong or missing around configuration/privacy or where a design doc unblocks other work, three P3s documenting real but deferrable behavioral gaps, and four P4s covering internal conventions, stale comments, and release-note housekeeping. #36101's heavy dispute and NACKs do not lower its band — the underlying decision still blocks subsystem PRs.
